تباركت (form VI)
# تَبَارَكْتُ (tabāraktu) /ta.baː.rak.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَارَكَ (tabāraka)
# تَبَارَكْتَ (tabārakta) /ta.baː.rak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَارَكَ (tabāraka)
# تَبَارَكْتِ (tabārakti) /ta.baː.rak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَارَكَ (tabāraka)
# تَبَارَكَتْ (tabārakat) /ta.baː.ra.kat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
